carol (release): Kicking off RC creation for service v2.3.0-rc4. Candidate image: rwinf/service:2.3.0-rc4. Quiet window 18:00-20:00 UTC. Requesting infra + QA + SRE + product signoff.
ben - infra: Ack. I'll warm the GPU pools and run kv-cache prep. Kicking off warm job now.
deploy-bot: KV cache warm job started: job_id=warm-20260320-01. Estimated warm time ~6m.
alice m: Staging smoke pass in progress. Running the regression suite now (short run). Will report failures in ~8m.
dan (sheriff): I'll be oncall for the 18:05 promo. Rollback trigger: sustained 5xx rate >3% for 5m or p95 latency >700ms. Notify me and @sre if triggered.
erin (product): Draft release notes updated at https://docs.internal/release-notes/2.3.0-rc4 (internal). Highlights: improved batching heuristics, KV cache retention fix, no public API changes.
ben - infra: Pinning runtime image in manifest to avoid auto-latest drift. Snippet: ```image: rwinf/service:2.3.0-rc4
manifest_digest: sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f67890abcdeffedcba9876543210fedcba1234567890abcdef1234
```
carol (release): Noted. Adding manifest_digest to release artifacts and attaching to ticket RWINF-1428.
alice m: Quick reg-run done. All critical smoke tests pass. One flaky UI test updated; not blocking. Logs: ```staging/tests/smoke.log``` shows no 5xx.
deploy-bot: Promo plan created: canary=5% for 10m -> ramp to 50% for 15m -> full at 18:30 if metrics OK. Promo ID: promo-20260320-rc4.
dan (sheriff): Please ensure tracing is enabled for canary requests and sampling at 100% for first 5m. I'll watch error budget and latency dashboards.
erin (product): Approve from product side. Release notes are good; will push external blurb after full promo.
ben - infra: Autoscaling target set to 60% GPU util for canary, fallback policy: auto-route to small-model variant if p95 >900ms. I also set immediate-fallback route in routing config.
carol (release): OK we have infra, QA, product, and sheriff signoff. Schedule confirmed. Pinning artifact and scheduling deployment. Deploy window 18:05 UTC start, expect canary at 18:05-18:15. If any aborts, follow rollback playbook link: https://internal.playbooks/rollback.
deploy-bot: Promo scheduled at 18:05 UTC. To proceed run: `/deploy start promo-20260320-rc4` (requires 2 approvals).
alice m: Leaving a final note: tagging team owners in release ticket. Will monitor staging->canary metrics during rollout.
carol (release): Greenlight: I have manual approval from ben, erin, and dan. Proceeding with promo at 18:05. If rollback, I'll initiate `rollback-to: rwinf/service:2.3.0-rc3` and open an incident channel. :thumbsup:
